title: Suhana Safar
desc: Enticed by his poetry, Sapna travels to India from the USA to meet poet Ujjwala. She meets a man, Sunil, who falls for her but decides to help her reach him in Phulwari.

title: Ek Hassina Do Deewane
desc: Amar, an orthodox businessman marries Neeta; slowly he starts mentally torturing her which leads to their divorce. Amar makes a deal with Neeta before filing for a divorce. Will she agree?

title: Raju Ban Gaya Gentleman
desc: As a newly graduated engineer loses track of what's important, his career starts to rise. When he falls in love with a beautiful young woman, he gets even more confused about what he wants.

title: Raaz
desc: A large mansion situated in Nairobi, resounds with the shrieks of its owner Kumar - a young man of Indian origin. Night after night he is woken up by three dreams - a woeful melody of a damsel in distress.
